items.html: And the matter is that it was already explained that on the first Shabbat they returned face to face, and still his Keter is greater than her Keter and higher than her; hence the Malchut within her is below all the aspects of ZA, and she has no place of suckling opposite the male, as above. Therefore the Malchut must ascend into her Yesod, and then there will also be a place of suckling for her Malchut. Hence it is found that of the seven lower firmaments within her, she already ascended, in the days of the first man, the first firmament from below upward, which is the aspect of her Malchut, and it ascended into her Yesod.
